name: r3d_setB_v1
purpose: Prompt R3d, the final gate under the owner's ship rule. Set D: R3c's three failing turns, exact wording and players, 3 runs each. Set B: the same ten case types as R3, R3b and R3c, 3 runs each, with NEW wording and NEW named / IN players versus all three; case 2 names a number of gameweeks and no number of transfers. Every named / IN player has exactly ONE player-lookup match and each swap previews as legal (checked by the plan step on a probe user, before any model call). Set C: three questions, one run each, gated on the zeros only.

placeholders.p1: the first named player of case 6
placeholders.in8: the player brought in in case 8
placeholders.in9: the player brought in in case 9

turns: Over the coming gameweeks, is Doku or Semenyo the better pick?
